create_datasets_make_regression: create regression dataset with make_regression using n_samples, n_features, noise, and random_state parameters
fit_linear_regression: fit a LinearRegression model to training data X and y and access its coefficients
fit_ransac_regressor: fit a RANSACRegressor model to data with outliers and retrieve inlier_mask for robust estimation
predict_ransac_model: predict responses from a fitted RANSACRegressor model using new input data
plot_inliers_outliers: plot inlier and outlier data points with fitted lines from LinearRegression and RANSACRegressor
